gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer native official APIs or AKShare-wrapped structured endpoints; avoid manual proxy fills.

gap_backlog.item: NBS property investment, floor-space starts/completions/sales, 70-city price index, land transactions, and inventory

AKShare/Eastmoney were traversed for inventory, sales-area, floor-space starts/completions, and land-sale series; no reusable API-backed indicator was found yet, and NBS EasyQuery is currently blocked by DNS/WAF in this environment.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer native official APIs or AKShare-wrapped structured endpoints; avoid manual proxy fills.

gap_backlog.item: Dutch TTF natural gas front-month benchmark futures
gap_backlog.status: ICE Endex exchange traded energy benchmark; critical European energy cost variable but exchange-licensed without a redistributable public API.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer FRED, Federal Reserve, BLS/Census/BEA, FiscalData, or Treasury source APIs.

gap_backlog.item: HCOB Eurozone Manufacturing and Services Flash PMIs
gap_backlog.status: Compiled by S&P Global under commercial license; proprietary data vendor series with no key-free redistributable API.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Check licensing before rendering; vendor surveys should stay as official gaps unless source-safe.

gap_backlog.item: Housing starts and mortgage rates
gap_backlog.status: MLIT construction starts require e-Stat credentials; Japanese mortgage rates are posted per-bank rather than as an official aggregate series.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer ONS, BoE IADB, HMRC/GOV.UK, OBR, or DESNZ endpoints before mirrors.

gap_backlog.item: Job-to-applicant ratio and shunto wage settlements
gap_backlog.status: MHLW job-openings statistics require e-Stat credentials; shunto outcomes are compiled by Rengo and are not redistributable as a public series.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer FRED, Federal Reserve, BLS/Census/BEA, FiscalData, or Treasury source APIs.

gap_backlog.item: CPI by COICOP division (food, housing, transport, and the other CP01-CP12 categories)
gap_backlog.status: OECD's Japan COICOP-division CPI mirror was discontinued after June 2021, and the IMF CPI dataset declares Japan's COICOP division keys (CP01-CP12) but returns them with no observations. The Statistics Bureau's e-Stat table carries these divisions too, but they are not yet wired here; only the goods/services split is chartable so far.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer ONS, BoE IADB, HMRC/GOV.UK, OBR, or DESNZ endpoints before mirrors.

gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer ONS, BoE IADB, HMRC/GOV.UK, OBR, or DESNZ endpoints before mirrors.

gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer ONS, BoE IADB, HMRC/GOV.UK, OBR, or DESNZ endpoints before mirrors.

gap_backlog.item: Istanbul Chamber of Industry / S&P Global Turkey Manufacturing PMI

gap_backlog.item: High-Frequency Monthly Seasonally Adjusted Unemployment Rate Time Series

gap_backlog.item: Nationwide, Halifax, Rightmove, Hometrack, and RICS

gap_backlog.item: Trends in Lending, Credit Conditions Survey, HEW, fuller quoted-rate matrix, and stale OECD 3M interbank mirror
gap_backlog.status: BoE IADB now covers Bank Rate, SONIA, sterling, 5Y/10Y nominal gilt par yields, M4, consumer credit, mortgage approvals, and one quoted-rate series. The lagged FRED/OECD 3M interbank mirror is intentionally not charted; use SONIA/Bank Rate for the short-rate channel until a validated BoE or market-data 3M term source is wired.
gap_backlog.source_hint: Prefer ONS, BoE IADB, HMRC/GOV.UK, OBR, or DESNZ endpoints before mirrors.

gap_backlog.item: Gross reserves level, and sovereign risk spread
gap_backlog.status: IMF BOP now supplies capital-flow detail (current account components, financial account and its direct/portfolio/other investment sub-categories, and the reserve-asset transaction flow); SARB's own reserves level series and BoP detail remain in the Quarterly Bulletin series set, which the public web API does not expose.
